title: Privacy Policy — Sephiria Guide
description: Privacy policy for sephiria-guide.com: analytics, cookies, and what we do not collect.
body:
This policy explains what sephiria-guide.com collects when you visit.

What we collect

  • Analytics. The site uses Google Analytics 4 (via a first-party script) to understand aggregate traffic: page views, approximate location, device, and referrer. GA may set cookies or use similar storage.
  • Hosting logs. Cloudflare may process standard request logs (IP, user agent, URL) for security and delivery.

What we do not collect

  • No account, no login, no newsletter signup on this site.
  • No payment data.
  • We do not sell personal information.

Advertising

This site does not display third-party ads today. If ads are added later, this page and ads.txt will be updated with the network and publisher details.

Contact
